svg.text: PyTorch-native LLM pretraining - DTensor / DeviceMesh - composable 4D+ parallelism
batch / tp / cp / pp / ep meshes

g.text: world = dp_replicate x dp_shard x tp x pp x cp

svg.text: Composable stages applied in order - each stage optional via ParallelDims
Stage 0: FSDP2 / HSDP / DDP - fully_shard() per-parameter DTensor - default 1D parallelism
Stage 1: Tensor Parallel - parallelize_module() plan - Async TP via SymmetricMemory (intra-node)
Stage 2: MoE EP/ETP (Llama4/DeepSeek/Qwen) - apply_moe_ep_tp() - all-to-all token dispatch
Stage 3: Context Parallel - ring attention in TP plan - long context (8K-1M seq)
Stage 4: Pipeline PP - torch.distributed.pipelining - 1F1B / Zero-Bubble / DualPipeV schedules
Stage 5: torch.compile + activation checkpointing (selective per-op or full) + Float8 quant
Meta device build: model on meta - parallelize - materialize shards on cuda - minimal peak host memory
Llama 3.1 recipes: 8B (1D@128 GPU) - 70B (2D@256) - 405B (3D@512) - 4D for long context
Unified tensor abstraction decouples model logic from parallel strategy
FSDP2 vs FSDP1: per-param DTensor sharding (not FlatParameter) - 7% lower mem - better composability
DCP checkpoints interoperable with torchtune - async save - elastic fault recovery via TorchFT
NVIDIA H100/B200 (SymmetricMemory/Float8) - multi-node Slurm/K8s/SkyPilot - elastic 8-512+ GPUs
Init path: ConfigManager - Trainer - ParallelDims/DeviceMesh - ModelSpec meta build - parallelize - materialize - train loop
Step path: dataloader batch - microbatch accum - forward/backward (or PP schedule) - clip_grad - optimizer - metrics - async ckpt
Sources: pytorch/torchtitan README - ICLR 2025 paper (arXiv:2410.06511) - Megatron-Core parallelism guide analog via DTensor docs
